cards.tz: 输入-处理-输出周期 (IPO cycle)
cards.en:
Intuition: think of a kitchen. Raw food goes in (input), the cook follows a recipe (process), and a finished dish comes out (output). The fridge keeps things for later (storage).

The rule: a computer turns data (raw facts, e.g. numbers) into information (data that has meaning, e.g. a chart) in three steps:

  • Input: data enters through input devices (keyboard, scanner...).
  • Process: a program (set of instructions) works on the data. Data in storage can be retrieved or updated here, so storage links to process in both directions.
  • Output: useful information leaves through output devices (monitor, printer...).

Textbook example: students' weights (data) → spreadsheet program on the CPU → saved on hard disk → histogram on screen (information).

Exam wording: Input devices capture data from the real world; the program processes the data (data in storage may be retrieved or updated); output devices output meaningful information.
cards.zh:
直觉：像厨房：食材放进去 (input)，厨师按食谱做 (process)，端出一道菜 (output)；冰箱 (storage) 存东西备用。

规则：计算机把数据 (data)（原始事实）变成信息 (information)（有意义的结果）：

  • Input：数据经输入设备进入。
  • Process：program 处理数据，期间可从 storage 读取或更新数据（双向）。
  • Output：有用的信息经输出设备输出。

课本例子：学生体重 (data) → 试算表程序 → 存到硬盘 → 直方图 (information)。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Input devices capture data from the real world; the program processes the data (data in storage may be retrieved or updated); output devices output meaningful information.

ex.q: A supermarket scans items at the checkout and prints a receipt. Identify the input, process, storage and output.
ex.a:
Input: product IDs read by the barcode scanner.
Process: the POS program looks up prices and adds the total.
Storage: product database is retrieved; stock records are updated.
Output: total shown on the display and the printed receipt.
ex.az: 输入：条码扫描器读到的产品编号；处理：POS 程序查价、计总数；储存：读取产品数据库并更新存货；输出：屏幕显示总数及打印收据。

ex.q: A student types marks into a spreadsheet and a bar chart appears. Identify input, process and output.
ex.a:
1. Input: the marks typed on the keyboard (data).
2. Process: the spreadsheet program calculates and builds the chart.
3. Output: the bar chart on the monitor (information).
ex.az:
1. 输入：键盘打入的分数 (data)。
2. 处理：试算表程序计算并画图。
3. 输出：显示器上的棒形图 (information)。

ex.q: A student writes: 'The hard disk is the process step because the data is kept there.' What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Mistake: storage is not processing. Keeping data is storage.
2. Processing is done by the program running on the CPU.
3. Correct: storage is linked to the process step, where data may be retrieved or updated.
ex.az:
1. 错误：储存不等于处理。
2. 处理由 CPU 上运行的 program 完成。
3. 正确写法：storage 与 process 相连，数据在处理时被 retrieved or updated。

frames.en: Students' weights are typed on the keyboard. These are raw data.
frames.zh: 用键盘输入学生体重，这是原始 data。

frames.en: The spreadsheet program groups the weights and counts each group.
frames.zh: 试算表 program 把体重分组并计数。

frames.en: The file is saved (updated) and can be retrieved later. Storage works both ways with process.
frames.zh: 档案被储存/更新，之后可再读取；storage 与 process 双向。

frames.en: A histogram appears on the monitor: meaningful information.
frames.zh: 显示器出现直方图：有意义的 information。

cards.en:
Intuition: a device must "talk" to the computer. It can use a cable (like a phone line) or the air (like a radio).

The rule: input devices do the first step of the IPO cycle: they capture data from the real world and transfer it to the computer.

TypeExampleHow it connects
Wiredwired mouse, wired keyboardUSB port (Universal Serial Bus)
Wirelesswireless mouse/keyboardRF (radio frequency), e.g. 2.4 GHz with a small USB receiver (dongle); Bluetooth; Wi-Fi
  • Wired: stable, no batteries.
  • Wireless: free to move, tidy desk, but needs power and may get interference.

Exam wording: Wired: USB port. Wireless: radio frequency (RF) e.g. 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi.
cards.zh:
直觉：设备要和计算机“说话”，可以用线（像电话线），也可以用空气（像收音机）。

规则：输入设备负责 IPO 第一步：capture data from the real world and transfer it to the computer。

  • 有线 (wired)：USB port。
  • 无线 (wireless)：RF 射频（如 2.4 GHz，配 USB 接收器）、Bluetooth、Wi-Fi。

有线稳定、不用电池；无线活动自由、桌面整齐，但要供电、可能受干扰。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Wired: USB port. Wireless: radio frequency (RF) e.g. 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi.

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.1 Q1) Which is/are common connection method(s) of a wireless mouse? (1) Bluetooth (2) USB cable (3) 2.4 GHz RF
ex.a: (1) and (3) are wireless methods. (2) USB cable is a wired method. Answer: (1) and (3) only.
ex.az: 蓝牙和 2.4 GHz 是无线方式；USB 线是有线，所以选 (1)(3)。

ex.q: A gamer complains that his wireless mouse sometimes lags. Give one reason and one fix.
ex.a:
1. Reason: wireless signals (RF/Bluetooth) can get interference or the battery is low.
2. Fix: use a wired USB connection, or move the receiver closer / change the battery.
ex.az:
1. 原因：无线信号受干扰或电池不足。
2. 解决：改用有线 USB，或把接收器移近、换电池。

ex.q: A student says: 'A 2.4 GHz mouse plugs into a USB port, so it is a wired mouse.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. The small thing in the USB port is only a receiver (dongle).
2. Between mouse and receiver, data travels by radio frequency, with no cable.
3. So it is a wireless mouse using RF (2.4 GHz).
ex.az:
1. USB 口上的只是接收器 (dongle)。
2. 鼠标和接收器之间用射频传送，没有线。
3. 所以是无线鼠标 (RF 2.4 GHz)。

cards.en:
Intuition: each key is like a button with its own ID number. Press it, and the ID is sent.

The rule:

  • A full-sized keyboard has 100 or more keys. Each key is represented by a unique code; pressing it sends the code to the computer.
  • A numeric keyboard (numpad) has mainly numbers and arithmetic operators. Used in banks and point-of-sale (POS) terminals, e.g. ATMs, for number input, password (PIN) input or calculation.
  • Layouts (enrichment): named after the first six letters, e.g. QWERTY (common), AZERTY (France). A tenkeyless keyboard has no numpad. A virtual keyboard appears on a touchscreen to save space.

Exam wording: Each key is represented by a unique code which is sent to the computer when pressed. Numpad: for number input, password (PIN) input or calculation in banks / POS terminals.
cards.zh:
直觉：每个键像有自己编号的按钮，按下就把编号送出。

规则：

  • 全尺寸键盘有 100 个以上按键，each key is represented by a unique code，按下时代码送到计算机。
  • Numpad 数字键盘：主要是数字和运算符号，用于银行、POS（如 ATM）输入数字、密码 (PIN) 或计算。
  • 布局 (layout)：以首六个字母命名，如 QWERTY、AZERTY（法国）；tenkeyless 没有 numpad；virtual keyboard 显示在触控屏上，节省空间。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Each key is represented by a unique code which is sent to the computer when pressed. Numpad: for number input, password (PIN) input or calculation.

ex.q: Why does an ATM use a numpad instead of a full keyboard?
ex.a: An ATM only needs numbers (PIN, amount). A numpad is smaller, simpler and faster for number input, and fewer keys means less chance of wrong input and less space.
ex.az: ATM 只需输入数字（密码、金额），数字键盘细小、简单、输入快，也较少出错。

ex.q: A laptop has no numpad but a user types many numbers in accounting work. Suggest a device.
ex.a:
1. Need: fast number entry.
2. Suggest an external USB numpad.
3. Reason: numbers and operators are grouped together, so number input is faster.
ex.az:
1. 需要：快速输入数字。
2. 建议外接 USB numpad。
3. 理由：数字和运算符集中，输入更快。

ex.q: A student says: 'When I press A, the keyboard sends the picture of the letter A to the computer.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. The keyboard does not send pictures.
2. Each key has a unique code; the code is sent.
3. The computer then decides what character to show.
ex.az:
1. 键盘不会传送图片。
2. 每个键有独特代码，送出的是代码。
3. 计算机再决定显示什么字符。

cards.en:
Intuition: people keep using what they already know, even if something better exists, because changing is hard.

The rule (history):

  • Old typewriters could jam (malfunction) when people typed too fast.
  • It is believed QWERTY was designed to reduce typing speed to protect typewriters.
  • Modern keyboards are durable, cheap and do not jam, so there is no technical reason to keep it.
  • But most users are used to QWERTY, and learning another layout takes too much effort. So QWERTY still dominates.

Exam wording: Most typists are accustomed to QWERTY; it would take too much effort (time and cost of retraining) to learn another layout.
cards.zh:
直觉：人会继续用已经习惯的东西，就算有更好的，因为转换很麻烦。

规则（历史）：

  • 旧打字机打太快会卡住 (jam)。
  • 据说 QWERTY 是为了降低打字速度而设计。
  • 现代键盘耐用、便宜、不会卡，技术上不需要 QWERTY。
  • 但大部分人已习惯 QWERTY，学新布局太花精力，所以 QWERTY 仍是主流。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Most typists are accustomed to QWERTY; it would take too much effort to learn another layout.

ex.q: A company proposes switching all office keyboards to a faster layout. Give one reason against.
ex.a: Staff are accustomed to QWERTY; retraining takes time and productivity will drop during the transition.
ex.az: 员工已习惯 QWERTY，重新学习要时间，过渡期效率会下降。

ex.q: Why do phones still show a QWERTY virtual keyboard, even though there is no typewriter jam on a phone?
ex.a:
1. A phone keyboard cannot jam.
2. But users already know QWERTY from computers.
3. Using the same layout means no need to learn a new layout.
ex.az:
1. 手机键盘不会卡。
2. 用户已熟悉 QWERTY。
3. 同一布局就不用学新布局。

ex.q: A student writes: 'QWERTY is used today because it is the fastest layout.' What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. QWERTY was believed to be designed to slow typing, not to be fastest.
2. It stays because of user habit and the effort to learn another layout.
ex.az:
1. QWERTY 据说是为了减慢打字而设计，不是最快。
2. 保留原因是用户习惯和学新布局的成本。

cards.tz: 定点设备：动作追踪与位置追踪
cards.en:
Intuition: a mouse is like steering a car: you move it a bit and the cursor moves a bit from where it was. A touchscreen is like pointing at a map: you touch exactly where you want.

The rule: a pointing device lets us interact with the interface: point, click, drag, drop, scroll, often moving a cursor.

TypeHow it worksExamples
Motion-trackingtracks the movement of the device (relative)mouse, trackball, joystick, racing wheel
Position-trackingtracks the position the user points at on the device (absolute)touchpad, touchscreen, graphics tablet

Some position-tracking devices accept handwriting with a finger or stylus.

Exam wording: Motion-tracking devices track the motion of the device; position-tracking devices track the position where the user points at the device.
cards.zh:
直觉：鼠标像开车：移一点，光标从原位置移一点。触控屏像指地图：直接点你要的位置。

规则：定点设备 (pointing device) 让我们与界面互动（点击、拖放、卷动等）。

  • Motion-tracking 动作追踪：追踪设备本身的移动：mouse、trackball、joystick、racing wheel。
  • Position-tracking 位置追踪：追踪用户指在设备上的位置：touchpad、touchscreen、graphics tablet。

部分位置追踪设备可用手指或 stylus 手写。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Motion-tracking devices track the motion of the device; position-tracking devices track the position where the user points at the device.

ex.q: Classify: trackball, graphics tablet, joystick, touchpad.
ex.a: Motion-tracking: trackball, joystick. Position-tracking: graphics tablet, touchpad.
ex.az: 动作追踪：轨迹球、游戏杆；位置追踪：绘图板、触控板。

ex.q: Classify a racing wheel and a touchscreen.
ex.a:
1. Racing wheel: you turn the wheel, its motion is tracked → motion-tracking.
2. Touchscreen: the position you tap is tracked → position-tracking.
ex.az:
1. 驾驶盘：追踪转动 → motion-tracking。
2. 触控屏：追踪点按位置 → position-tracking。

ex.q: A student classifies a touchpad as motion-tracking 'because you move your finger on it'. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. The touchpad itself does not move.
2. It senses where your finger is on its surface.
3. So it is position-tracking (as in the textbook).
ex.az:
1. 触控板本身不动。
2. 它感应手指在表面的位置。
3. 所以是 position-tracking。

cards.t: Computer mouse (optical, LED vs laser, mechanical)
cards.tz: 鼠标：光学、LED 与激光、机械
cards.en:
Intuition: an optical mouse is a tiny camera looking at the desk. It watches the surface pattern slide by and works out how far it moved.

The rule: a mouse has at least two buttons and usually a scroll wheel (also a third button). Extra buttons can control volume, cursor speed, cut/copy/paste.

  • Optical mouse: light source + light sensor at the bottom; detects movement from the change of reflected light.
  • LED mouse: usually fails on reflective (mirror) or transparent (glass) surfaces.
  • Laser mouse: works better there, because laser gives a clearer image.
  • Mechanical mouse (ball): obsolete: inconsistent on different surfaces, heavy, low durability, high production cost.

Exam wording: An optical mouse uses a light source and a light sensor to detect the change of reflected light. An LED mouse may not work on reflective or transparent surfaces; a laser mouse can.
cards.zh:
直觉：光学鼠标像一部对着桌面的迷你相机，看表面花纹移动来计算距离。

规则：鼠标至少两个键，通常有滚轮（也可作第三键）。

  • 光学鼠标：底部有光源和光感应器，根据反射光的变化侦测移动。
  • LED 鼠标：在反光（镜面）或透明（玻璃）表面通常不能用。
  • 激光鼠标：影像更清晰，可在这些表面使用。
  • 机械鼠标（滚球）已淘汰：不同表面表现不一致、重、不耐用、成本高。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：An optical mouse uses a light source and a light sensor to detect the change of reflected light. An LED mouse may not work on reflective or transparent surfaces; a laser mouse can.

ex.q: A user's mouse cursor does not move on a glass desk. Suggest the cause and a fix.
ex.a: It is probably an LED optical mouse; glass is transparent so the reflected light barely changes. Fix: use a mouse pad or switch to a laser mouse.
ex.az: 多数是 LED 滑鼠，玻璃透明令反射光变化不明显；用滑鼠垫或改用激光滑鼠。

ex.q: Give two reasons why mechanical mice are no longer used.
ex.a:
1. Limited consistency on different surfaces (the ball slips or gets dirty).
2. Heavy, low durability, high production cost (any two).
ex.az:
1. 在不同表面表现不一致。
2. 重、不耐用、生产成本高（任两项）。

ex.q: A student says: 'An LED mouse fails on glass because the glass blocks the radio signal.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. The problem is not radio signal.
2. The sensor needs reflected light from the surface; glass is transparent so little light comes back.
3. Fix: use a laser mouse or a mouse pad.
ex.az:
1. 问题不是无线信号。
2. 感应器需要表面反射光；玻璃透明，反射很少。
3. 解决：用激光鼠标或鼠标垫。

demo.title: How an optical mouse senses movement

frames.en: The light source (LED or laser) shines on the desk.
frames.zh: 光源（LED 或激光）照向桌面。

frames.en: The light sensor takes many tiny images of the reflected light.
frames.zh: 光感应器拍下反射光的细小影像。

frames.en: It compares images: the change shows direction and distance. On glass, too little light returns, so an LED mouse fails.
frames.zh: 比较影像的变化得出方向和距离；在玻璃上反射光太少，LED 鼠标失效。

frames.en: Movement data is sent; the cursor moves.
frames.zh: 送出移动数据，光标移动。

cards.tz: 轨迹球、游戏杆与驾驶盘
cards.en:
Intuition: a trackball is an upside-down mouse: the device stays still and you roll the ball with your thumb or palm.

The rule:

  • Trackball: a ball in a socket; it tracks the rolling of the ball. Buttons around it do clicking.
  • Advantages over a mouse: does not depend on the surface, needs less space, its position can be fixed (cannot be taken away). So it is common on public information kiosks.
  • Joysticks and racing wheels: motion-tracking devices for gaming and driver training; give a more realistic experience and let people learn to drive in a safe place.

Exam wording: A trackball does not depend on the surface, needs less space and its position can be fixed.
cards.zh:
直觉：轨迹球像倒转的鼠标：设备不动，你用拇指或手掌滚球。

规则：

  • Trackball：球装在座里，追踪球的滚动。
  • 比鼠标好：不受表面影响、占用空间少、可固定位置（不会被拿走），常见于公共资讯站 (kiosk)。
  • Joystick / racing wheel：用于游戏和驾驶训练，体验更真实，可在安全环境学车。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A trackball does not depend on the surface, needs less space and its position can be fixed.

ex.q: Why does a public information kiosk use a trackball rather than a mouse?
ex.a: The trackball can be fixed in position (cannot be taken away), needs little space, and works regardless of surface.
ex.az: 可固定、不会被拿走；占位少；不受表面影响。

ex.q: A driving school wants beginners to practise before driving on real roads. Suggest an input device and one benefit.
ex.a:
1. Device: a racing wheel (with pedals) in a driving simulator.
2. Benefit: learners can learn to drive in a safe place with a realistic experience.
ex.az:
1. 设备：驾驶模拟器的 racing wheel。
2. 好处：在安全环境真实地练习驾驶。

ex.q: A student says a trackball is better for a kiosk 'because it is a position-tracking device'. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. A trackball is motion-tracking (it tracks the rolling).
2. The real reasons: fixed position (cannot be stolen), less space, not surface-dependent.
ex.az:
1. 轨迹球是 motion-tracking。
2. 真正原因：可固定（不会被偷）、省空间、不受表面影响。

cards.en:
Intuition: a touchpad is a small "remote" for the cursor; a touchscreen lets you touch the thing itself.

The rule:

  • Touchpad (laptops): detects motion and pressure of fingers. Tap = left-click; right-click/scroll by buttons or gestures. Multi-touch = detects more than one finger at the same time (e.g. pinch to zoom).
  • Touchscreen: both input and output device; the cursor goes to the exact position tapped.
Touchscreen vs mouse
+ easier to operate (better hand-eye coordination)
+ less working space
- some actions hard or impossible, e.g. mouse-over
- more expensive

Exam wording: A touchscreen is both an input and output device; easier to operate with better hand-eye coordination and needs less working space, but more expensive and cannot perform mouse-over.
cards.zh:
直觉：触控板是光标的“小遥控”；触控屏让你直接摸到目标本身。

规则：

  • Touchpad：侦测手指移动和压力；点一下 = 左键；支持 multi-touch（同时侦测多于一只手指，如双指缩放）。
  • Touchscreen：既是输入也是输出设备，光标到达点按的确切位置。

与鼠标比：较易操作（手眼协调好）、省空间；但难做 mouse-over、较贵。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A touchscreen is both an input and output device; easier to operate with better hand-eye coordination and needs less working space, but more expensive and cannot perform mouse-over.

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.1 Q1) Advantage(s) of a mouse over a touchscreen: (1) lower purchase cost (2) better hand-eye coordination (3) faster text input
ex.a: (1) correct: touchscreens are more expensive. (2) wrong: that is the touchscreen's advantage. (3) neither device is for text input. Answer: (1) only.
ex.az: (1) 对；(2) 是触控屏的优点；(3) 两者都不是文字输入设备。答案 (1) only。

ex.q: A fast-food shop chooses touchscreens for ordering kiosks. Give two reasons.
ex.a:
1. Easy to operate: customers tap pictures directly.
2. Input and output in one device, so no extra space for keyboard and mouse.
ex.az:
1. 易用：顾客直接点图片。
2. 输入输出合一，不用额外空间放键盘鼠标。

ex.q: A student writes: 'Multi-touch means the touchscreen can be used by many users on different days.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Multi-touch is about fingers at the same time, not users over time.
2. Correct: it detects gestures with more than one finger simultaneously, e.g. pinch to zoom.
ex.az:
1. Multi-touch 指同时多只手指。
2. 正确：同时侦测多于一只手指的手势，如双指缩放。

cards.en:
Intuition: it is like paper and a pencil that the computer can feel: press harder, get a darker, thicker line.

The rule: a graphics tablet (drawing pad / digital art board) is a position-tracking pointing device used by graphics designers. Compared with a touchscreen:

  • it is controlled by a pen (stylus);
  • it has up to 8000 pressure sensitivity levels, so line thickness/darkness follows pen pressure.

Best for illustrations and comics; also helps handwriting input (e.g. Chinese characters).

Exam wording: A graphics tablet is controlled by a stylus and has many (up to 8000) pressure sensitivity levels, so it is suitable for drawing.
cards.zh:
直觉：像计算机“感觉得到”的纸和笔：压得越大力，线越粗越深。

规则：Graphics tablet（绘图板）是 position-tracking 设备，设计师常用。与触控屏不同：

  • 用压感笔 (stylus) 控制；
  • 有高达 8000 级压力感应 (pressure sensitivity levels)。

最适合画插画、漫画，也可手写输入中文。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A graphics tablet is controlled by a stylus and has many (up to 8000) pressure sensitivity levels, so it is suitable for drawing.

ex.q: Which device is most suitable for creating comic illustrations: mouse, touchscreen, drawing tablet, trackball?
ex.a: Drawing (graphics) tablet: pen control and many pressure levels give natural strokes.
ex.az: 绘图板：用笔，并有大量压力感应级别。

ex.q: An elderly user cannot type Chinese input methods. Suggest a device.
ex.a:
1. Suggest a graphics tablet (or touchscreen) with a stylus.
2. He can handwrite characters, and handwriting recognition turns them into text.
ex.az:
1. 建议 graphics tablet 配 stylus。
2. 可手写中文字，再由手写识别转成文字。

ex.q: A student says a graphics tablet is better than a mouse for drawing 'because it has a higher resolution screen'. What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Many graphics tablets have no screen at all.
2. The real reason: stylus control and pressure sensitivity (line thickness changes with pressure).
ex.az:
1. 很多绘图板根本没有屏幕。
2. 真正原因：用笔控制及压力感应。

cards.t: Audio input: microphone, speech recognition, MIDI keyboard
cards.tz: 音频输入：麦克风、语音识别、MIDI 键盘
cards.en:
Intuition: a microphone records the actual sound, like a voice recording. A MIDI keyboard records only which notes you played, like writing sheet music.

The rule: audio input devices create digital audio files.

  • Microphone: turns analog sound waves into electrical signals; the sound card converts them to digital audio.
  • Speech recognition: speak to input text or commands (e.g. Siri, Google Assistant).
  • MIDI keyboard: MIDI (Musical Instrument Digital Interface) stores musical notes, not recorded sound. It is not affected by ambient (background) noise.

Exam wording: A microphone converts analog sound waves into electrical signals, which the sound card converts into digital audio. A MIDI keyboard stores musical notes and is not affected by ambient noise.
cards.zh:
直觉：麦克风录下真正的声音，像录音；MIDI 键盘只记下弹了哪些音符，像写乐谱。

规则：音频输入设备产生数码音频档。

  • Microphone：把模拟声波 (analog sound waves) 变成电子信号，再由声卡 (sound card) 转成数码音频。
  • Speech recognition：用声音输入文字或指令（如 Siri）。
  • MIDI keyboard：MIDI 储存音符而非录音，不受环境噪音影响。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A microphone converts analog sound waves into electrical signals; a MIDI keyboard stores musical notes and is not affected by ambient noise.

ex.q: A composer records a melody in a noisy room. Microphone or MIDI keyboard? Why?
ex.a: MIDI keyboard: it records note data directly, so ambient noise does not affect it; notes can also be edited later.
ex.az: MIDI 键盘：直接记录音符，不受噪音影响，之后可编辑。

ex.q: A user with a hand injury wants to write an email. Suggest an input method.
ex.a:
1. Use a microphone with speech recognition.
2. The user speaks; the software converts speech into text.
ex.az:
1. 用麦克风 + 语音识别。
2. 说话后软件把语音转成文字。

ex.q: A student says: 'A MIDI file is a recording of the piano sound, like an MP3.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. MIDI does not store the recorded sound wave.
2. It stores musical notes (which note, how long, how hard).
3. That is why it is not affected by ambient noise.
ex.az:
1. MIDI 不储存录下的声波。
2. 它储存音符资料。
3. 所以不受环境噪音影响。

cards.en:
Intuition: a scanner is a photocopier that gives you a file instead of paper.

The rule: a flatbed scanner presses the object flat, shines white light on it and reads the reflected light with image sensors.

SpecMeaningAffects quality?
Max document sizeusually up to A3No
Pixel densitydots per inch (dpi/ppi); often called "resolution"Yes
Colour depthbits per pixel → number of coloursYes
File formatsets compression; JPEG is lossyYes
Memorybuilt-in RAM holds images during transferNo
InterfaceUSB or Wi-Fi (802.11n/ac)No

3D scanners make a digital 3D model (e.g. a patient's teeth).

Exam wording: Higher pixel density (dpi) and colour depth give better image quality; a lossy format such as JPEG lowers quality; the interface does not affect image quality.
cards.zh:
直觉：扫描器就像给你档案而不是纸张的影印机。

规则：平板扫描器把物件压平、照白光、用影像感应器读取反射光。

  • Pixel density (dpi)：越高越清晰（影响质素）。
  • Colour depth（位元）：越高颜色越多（影响质素）。
  • File format：决定压缩，JPEG 有损（影响质素）。
  • 文件尺寸上限（通常 A3）、RAM、interface（USB / 802.11n）不影响质素。

3D scanner 可制作物件的 3D 模型（如牙齿）。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Higher pixel density (dpi) and colour depth give better image quality; a lossy format such as JPEG lowers quality; the interface does not affect image quality.

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.1 Q2) Which affect scanned image quality? (1) 4800 dpi (2) 802.11n supported (3) JPEG format
ex.a: (1) pixel density: affects quality. (2) connection only: no effect. (3) JPEG is lossy, lower quality than BMP/PNG: affects. Answer: (1) and (3) only.
ex.az: (1) 像素密度影响；(2) 只是连接方式；(3) JPEG 有损压缩影响质素。答案 (1)(3)。

ex.q: Scanner P: 1200 dpi, 24-bit. Scanner Q: 600 dpi, 48-bit. Which gives sharper detail, and which gives more colours?
ex.a:
1. Sharper detail depends on pixel density: P (1200 dpi) is sharper.
2. More colours depends on colour depth: Q (48-bit) has more colours.
ex.az:
1. 细节看 dpi：P 较清晰。
2. 颜色数看 colour depth：Q 较多。

ex.q: A student says: 'Scanner B supports 802.11ac, so its images are clearer than Scanner A's.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. 802.11ac is a Wi-Fi interface standard; it only affects how data is transferred.
2. The interface does not affect image quality; compare dpi and colour depth instead.
ex.az:
1. 802.11ac 是 Wi-Fi 介面标准，只影响传送。
2. Interface 不影响影像质素，应比较 dpi 和 colour depth。

cards.t: Calculating scanned image resolution and file size
cards.tz: 计算扫描影像解像度及档案大小
cards.en:
Intuition: dpi = how many dots across each inch. More inches or more dots per inch → more pixels → bigger file.

The rule:

  • Width (pixels) = width (inches) × dpi; height (pixels) = height (inches) × dpi.
  • Uncompressed file size (bytes) = width px × height px × (colour depth ÷ 8).
  • 1 KB = 1024 bytes; 1 MB = 10242 = 1,048,576 bytes.

A4 (8.3 × 11.7 in) at 300 dpi, 24-bit: 2490 × 3510 px; 2490 × 3510 × 3 = 26,219,700 bytes ≈ 25.0 MB.

Double the dpi → 4 times the pixels (width and height both double).

Exam wording: Resolution = (width × dpi) × (height × dpi); file size = number of pixels × colour depth ÷ 8 bytes.
cards.zh:
直觉：dpi 是每英寸有多少点。英寸越多或每英寸点越多 → 像素越多 → 档案越大。

规则：

  • 宽（像素）= 宽（英寸）× dpi；高同理。
  • 未压缩档案大小 (bytes) = 宽 × 高 × (colour depth ÷ 8)。
  • 1 KB = 1024 bytes；1 MB = 1024² bytes。

A4 (8.3 × 11.7 in)、300 dpi、24-bit：2490 × 3510 px，约 25.0 MB。

dpi 加倍 → 像素变 4 倍。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Resolution = (width × dpi) × (height × dpi); file size = number of pixels × colour depth ÷ 8 bytes.

ex.q: A 4 × 6 inch photo is scanned at 600 dpi, 24-bit, uncompressed. Find the resolution and file size in MB.
A 4 × 6 inch photo is scanned at 300 dpi in 8-bit greyscale, uncompressed. Find the file size in KB.
A student says: 'If I change 300 dpi to 600 dpi, the file becomes 2 times bigger.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Both width and height pixels double.
2. Pixels × 2 × 2 = 4 times.
3. So the uncompressed file is 4 times bigger (e.g. A4 24-bit: ≈25.0 MB → ≈100.0 MB).

frames.zh: 24-bit = 3 bytes/像素 → 25,920,000 bytes

cards.en:
Intuition: a scanned page is just a photo. You see words, but to the computer it is only coloured dots. OCR "reads" the dots and types the words for you.

The rule:

  • A scan gives a digital image file; you cannot search or edit its text.
  • OCR (optical character recognition) software converts an image into a text file, enabling word processing and data analysis.
  • Examples: Microsoft OneNote, Adobe Acrobat, Google Docs. It can even read some handwriting.
  • Don't mix up with OMR, which only reads marks (darkened circles).

Exam wording: Use a scanner to capture the document as an image, then OCR software converts the image into a text file for editing/searching.
cards.zh:
直觉：扫描后的页面只是一张相片，对计算机来说只是彩色点。OCR 帮你“读”出文字并打出来。

规则：

  • 扫描得到影像档，不能搜寻或编辑文字。
  • OCR 软件把影像转成文字档 (text file)，方便文书处理和数据分析。
  • 例子：OneNote、Adobe Acrobat、Google Docs，部分可读手写字。
  • 不要和 OMR 混淆：OMR 只读标记。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Use a scanner to capture the document as an image, then OCR software converts the image into a text file.

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.1 Q3) Oscar types paper inquiry forms into a database. Suggest a device and technology.
ex.a: Use an image scanner to scan the forms into images, then OCR software to convert the images into text, which can be imported into the database. This saves typing time and reduces input errors.
ex.az: 用扫描器扫描表格，再用 OCR 转成文字导入数据库，省时并减少输入错误。

ex.q: A lawyer has 500 old printed contracts and wants to search them for a client's name. What should be done?
ex.a:
1. Scan the contracts → image files.
2. Run OCR → text files.
3. Now the text can be searched by keyword.
ex.az:
1. 扫描合约 → 影像档。
2. 用 OCR → 文字档。
3. 就可以用关键字搜寻。

ex.q: A student says: 'After scanning a letter at high dpi, I can search its words with Ctrl+F.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Higher dpi only makes a sharper image.
2. It is still an image, not text, so Ctrl+F finds nothing.
3. You need OCR to convert it into text first.
ex.az:
1. 高 dpi 只令影像更清晰。
2. 仍是影像，不能搜寻。
3. 必须先用 OCR 转成文字。

demo.title: Paper to editable text with OCR

frames.en: The scanner shines light on the paper and reads reflected light.
frames.zh: 扫描器照射纸张并读取反射光。

frames.en: Result: an image made of pixels. Words cannot be searched yet.
frames.zh: 得到由像素组成的影像，还不能搜寻文字。

frames.en: OCR finds the shape of each character and matches it to a letter.
frames.zh: OCR 找出每个字符的形状并配对成字母。

frames.en: Output: a text file that can be edited, searched and analysed.
frames.zh: 输出可编辑、可搜寻的文字档。

cards.t: Digital camera, digital video camera and webcam
cards.tz: 数码相机、数码摄像机与网络摄像头
cards.en:
Intuition: a camera takes photos, a video camera makes movies, a webcam is a live TV camera for your computer.

The rule:

  • Digital camera: captures still images with image sensors; saves to memory cards.
  • Digital video camera: also has a built-in microphone and records video.
  • Webcam: not handheld/portable; connects directly to a computer and streams online. Fast streaming is gained at the cost of video quality. Used for video conferencing and monitoring.

Exam wording: A webcam connects directly to a computer and streams video online, at the cost of video quality; used for video conferencing and video monitoring.
cards.zh:
直觉：相机拍照、摄像机拍片、webcam 是计算机的“直播镜头”。

规则：

  • Digital camera：用影像感应器拍静态影像，存在记忆卡。
  • Digital video camera：有内置麦克风，可录影。
  • Webcam：不是手提设备，直接连接计算机并网上串流，以牺牲画质换取频繁传送；用于视像会议、监察。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A webcam connects directly to a computer and streams video online, at the cost of video quality.

ex.q: A teacher wants to stream her lesson live to students at home. Which camera?
ex.a: A webcam: it connects directly to the computer and streams online in real time.
ex.az: 用 webcam，直接接电脑实时串流。

ex.q: A wedding couple wants a high-quality video of their ceremony. Webcam or digital video camera?
ex.a:
1. They need high quality, not live streaming.
2. Choose a digital video camera: portable, records video with sound in good quality.
ex.az:
1. 需要高画质而非直播。
2. 选数码摄像机：可携带、高质素录影录音。

ex.q: A student says: 'Webcams have the best video quality because they are used for live meetings.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Webcams stream data often, so quality is lowered to keep it fast.
2. Correct: streaming is achieved at the cost of video quality.
ex.az:
1. Webcam 要频繁传送，画质会降低。
2. 正确：串流是以画质为代价。

cards.t: Automatic input devices and optical readers
cards.tz: 自动输入设备与光学阅读器
cards.en:
Intuition: instead of a person typing, a machine reads the data by itself, quickly and without typos.

The rule:

  • Automatic input devices (barcode scanner, card reader, OMR, sensors) input data automatically with minimal human effort.
  • They often convert between media types, e.g. image → text string.
  • Benefit: they drastically reduce input time and input errors.
  • An optical reader scans visual data and turns it into numbers or text strings: barcode scanner, QR code scanner, OMR.

Exam wording: Automatic input devices input data with minimal human effort, reducing input time and input errors.
cards.zh:
直觉：不用人打字，机器自己读数据，又快又不会打错。

规则：

  • 自动输入设备（条码扫描器、读卡器、OMR、传感器）以最少人力自动输入数据。
  • 常涉及多媒体类型转换，如影像 → 文字串。
  • 好处：大幅减少输入时间和错误。
  • 光学阅读器 (optical reader) 扫描视觉数据并转成数字/文字串：条码、QR code 扫描器、OMR。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Automatic input devices input data with minimal human effort, reducing input time and input errors.

ex.q: State two benefits of automatic input devices over manual typing in a library.
ex.a: Faster input (almost instant); fewer human errors (no mistyping of ISBNs).
ex.az: 输入快；人为错误少。

ex.q: Which of these are optical readers: barcode scanner, smart card reader, OMR, temperature sensor?
ex.a:
1. Optical readers read visual data with light.
2. Barcode scanner and OMR are optical readers.
3. Smart card reader (chip/radio) and temperature sensor are automatic input devices but not optical.
ex.az:
1. 光学阅读器读视觉数据。
2. 条码扫描器、OMR 是。
3. 智能卡读卡器和温度传感器是自动输入但不是光学。

ex.q: A student writes: 'Automatic input devices need no humans at all, so errors are impossible.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. They need minimal human effort, not zero (someone still scans the item).
2. Errors are reduced, not impossible (e.g. damaged barcode).
ex.az:
1. 只是极少人力，不是零。
2. 错误是减少，不是不可能（如条码损坏）。

cards.en:
Intuition: a barcode is a short ID number written in stripes. A QR code is a small square that can hold a whole sentence or a web link.

The rule:

  • Barcodes hold key info such as product IDs and ISBN (standard e.g. International Article Number). A barcode scanner turns them into sequences of characters, so stock/book records update almost instantly with minimal human error.
  • QR (Quick Response) codes are 2D barcodes. They can hold text with any characters: phone numbers, emails, URLs. Uses: payment, discounts, signing in.
  • Both can be read by a scanner or a mobile app. A QR code that misses its corner position patterns or is too damaged cannot be read.

Exam wording: A barcode scanner converts a barcode into a sequence of characters (e.g. product ID); a QR code is a 2D barcode that can store text strings with any characters such as URLs.
cards.zh:
直觉：条码是用线条写的短编号；QR code 是能装一整句话或网址的小方格。

规则：

  • Barcode 存产品编号、ISBN；扫描器把它转成字符序列，存货几乎即时更新、极少人为错误。
  • QR code 是二维条码，可存任何字符的文字：电话、电邮、URL；用于付款、优惠、签到。
  • 可用扫描器或手机 app 读取；缺了角落定位图案或损坏太多就读不到。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A barcode scanner converts a barcode into a sequence of characters; a QR code is a 2D barcode that can store text strings with any characters such as URLs.

ex.q: Why does a shop use QR codes rather than barcodes for its website link?
ex.a: A URL contains letters and symbols; a barcode typically stores only a sequence of numbers, while a QR code can store text with any characters.
ex.az: URL 有字母和符号，条码一般只有数字，QR code 可存任何字符。

ex.q: A library scans a book's barcode at the counter. Describe what happens.
ex.a:
1. Scanner reads the barcode → ISBN/book ID as characters.
2. Program looks up the book in the database.
3. Book status is updated to "on loan" almost instantly.
ex.az:
1. 扫描器读出 ISBN/书号。
2. 程序在数据库查书。
3. 书的状态即时改为“借出”。

ex.q: A student says: 'A QR code is just a bigger barcode that stores product IDs only.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. A QR code is two-dimensional.
2. It can store text strings with any characters, e.g. URLs, emails, not only numbers.
ex.az:
1. QR code 是二维的。
2. 可存任何字符的文字（如网址），不只数字。

frames.en: The scanner shines light; dark bars reflect little, white gaps reflect a lot.
frames.zh: 扫描器照光；黑条反射少，白位反射多。

frames.en: The pattern is decoded into a sequence of characters: the product ID.
frames.zh: 图案被解码成字符序列：产品编号。

frames.en: The program finds name and price, and updates the stock.
frames.zh: 程序查出名称、价钱，并更新存货。

frames.en: Name and price appear on the display and receipt.
frames.zh: 名称价钱显示在屏幕和收据上。

cards.en:
Intuition: OMR only asks one question per box: "is this circle dark or not?" It cannot read words.

The rule:

  • An optical mark reader scans specific symbols; the method is optical mark recognition (OMR).
  • Used for MC answer sheets and questionnaires: data read in seconds, fewer human errors than hand marking.
  • Circles must be darkened completely: a partly darkened circle may not be read.
  • OMR cannot convert free text into a text file; that needs OCR.

Exam wording: OMR reads specific marks such as darkened circles quickly with fewer errors; it cannot recognise text, which requires OCR.
cards.zh:
直觉：OMR 每格只问一件事：“这个圆圈涂黑了没有？”它不会读字。

规则：

  • Optical mark reader 扫描特定符号，方法叫 OMR。
  • 用于 MC 答题纸、问卷：几秒读完，比人手少错。
  • 圆圈要完全涂黑，涂一半可能读不到。
  • OMR 不能把文字转成文字档，要用 OCR。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：OMR reads specific marks such as darkened circles quickly with fewer errors; it cannot recognise text, which requires OCR.

ex.q: (Textbook Ch1 Long Q5(b)) Peter suggests OMR to convert photographed text descriptions into a text file. Agree?
ex.a: Disagree. OMR only reads specific marks (e.g. darkened circles) at fixed positions, not general characters. She should use OCR, which converts an image of text into a text file.
ex.az: 不同意：OMR 只读特定标记；应用 OCR 把文字影像转成文字档。

ex.q: A school surveys 1200 students about canteen food. Suggest an input method and one design rule for the form.
ex.a:
1. Use OMR forms with answer circles.
2. Rule: give fixed choices and ask students to darken circles completely with a pencil.
ex.az:
1. 用 OMR 问卷。
2. 设计：给固定选项，要求完全涂黑圆圈。

ex.q: A student writes in an MC exam: 'I just put a tick in the circle; the machine will understand.' Explain the risk.
ex.a:
1. OMR looks for a fully darkened mark.
2. A tick covers little area, so the reader may fail to read it.
3. The answer may be marked blank and lose marks.
ex.az:
1. OMR 找的是完全涂黑的标记。
2. 打勾面积小，可能读不到。
3. 可能当作空白而失分。

cards.t: Magnetic stripe cards vs smart cards
cards.en:
Intuition: a magnetic stripe is like an old cassette tape: easy to wipe and easy to copy. A smart card has a tiny computer chip inside, which is harder to copy.

The rule: both are used for authentication (access cards, ATM cards, credit cards).

Magnetic stripe cardSmart card
Stores data inmagnetic stripemicrochip
Read byswiping (sensing magnetism)insert, or tap (contactless) via RFID / NFC
Weaknesseasily damaged and replicatedmore secure, more durable

Magnetic stripe cards are being replaced by smart cards (e.g. Octopus is contactless).

Exam wording: Magnetic stripe cards are prone to damage and easily replicated; smart cards store data in a microchip and some communicate contactlessly via RFID/NFC.
cards.zh:
直觉：磁条像旧录音带，容易被洗掉和复制；智能卡内有微型芯片，难以复制。

规则：两者都用于身份验证 (authentication)。

  • 磁条卡：数据在磁条，刷卡读取（感应磁性），易损坏、易被复制。
  • 智能卡：数据在微芯片 (microchip)，部分用 RFID / NFC 非接触式拍卡（如八达通）。

磁条卡正被智能卡取代。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Magnetic stripe cards are prone to damage and easily replicated; smart cards store data in a microchip and some communicate contactlessly via RFID/NFC.

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.1 Q2) Correct statements? (1) Magnetic stripe cards are more durable than smart cards (2) Smart cards store data in microchips (3) Smart cards are harder to replicate
ex.a: (1) false: stripe cards are prone to damage. (2) true. (3) true. Answer: (2) and (3) only.

ex.q: A gym replaces swipe cards with tap cards. Give two benefits.
ex.a:
1. Harder to replicate (data in a microchip) → better security.
2. Contactless tapping is faster and causes less wear, so cards last longer.
ex.az:
1. 难以复制 → 较安全。
2. 非接触式拍卡较快，磨损少。

ex.q: A student says: 'All smart cards are contactless.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. A smart card stores data in a microchip.
2. Some have RFID/NFC for contactless use; others must be inserted (e.g. chip credit card in a reader).
ex.az:
1. 智能卡数据在微芯片。
2. 只有部分有 RFID/NFC，有些要插卡。

cards.en:
Intuition: sensors are the computer's senses: they "feel" light, heat or distance and turn it into numbers.

The rule: a sensor reads physical quantities from the environment and turns them into data; the system can then act (via an output device).

SensorMeasuresUse
Lightbrightnessauto screen brightness, automatic lights
Ultrasonicdistanceautomatic hand washer, parking aid
Compassdirectionnavigation
Temperature / humiditytemperature, humidityair-conditioning, overheat protection
Gyroscopeorientationrotating the phone screen

Book note: a sensor converts one form of energy into another, so some people call it a transducer. Physical quantities in the book table: brightness (light/photoresistor sensor: auto-brightness, automatic lighting), distance (ultrasonic: automatic hand washer, parking), direction (compass), temperature and humidity (car air-con), orientation (gyroscope).

Exam wording: A sensor reads a physical quantity (e.g. temperature, light, distance) from the environment and inputs it to the computer automatically.
cards.zh:
直觉：传感器是计算机的感官：感觉光、热、距离，再变成数字。

规则：Sensor 读取环境的物理量转成数据，系统再按数据行动。

  • Light 光度：自动调光。
  • Ultrasonic 超声波：距离（自动洗手机、泊车）。
  • Compass：方向（导航）。
  • Temperature / humidity：冷气、过热保护。
  • Gyroscope：方向角度（转屏）。

课本补充：sensor 把一种能量转换成另一种能量，所以也有人叫它 transducer。课本表：亮度（light/photoresistor sensor：自动亮度、自动亮灯）、距离（ultrasonic：自动洗手机、泊车）、方向（compass：导航）、温度湿度（汽车冷气）、方向角度（gyroscope：转屏）。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A sensor reads a physical quantity (e.g. temperature, light, distance) from the environment and inputs it to the computer automatically.

ex.q: A drill should stop when overheated. Which sensor?
ex.a: Temperature (and humidity) sensor: it measures temperature so the drill can halt above a threshold.
ex.az: 温度感应器。

ex.q: A phone screen turns sideways when you rotate the phone. Which sensor? Describe the IPO.
ex.a:
1. Sensor: gyroscope.
2. Input: orientation reading.
3. Process: program decides the phone is sideways.
4. Output: screen shows landscape view.
ex.az:
1. 陀螺仪 gyroscope。
2. 输入方向数据 → 程序判断横放 → 输出横向画面。

ex.q: A student suggests a light sensor for an automatic tap that turns on when hands are near. Is it the best choice?
ex.a:
1. The tap needs to know distance of the hands, not brightness.
2. A light sensor could be fooled by room lighting.
3. Better: an ultrasonic sensor (measures distance).
ex.az:
1. 需要量度手的距离而非光度。
2. 光度传感器会受室内灯光影响。
3. 应用超声波传感器。

cards.en:
Intuition: your body is your password: you cannot forget your finger at home.

The rule:

  • Biometric devices read physical or behavioural characteristics: fingerprint, face, iris, voice.
  • Used for authentication, because it is unlikely or impossible for two people to share the same characteristics.
  • + cannot be forgotten, lost or lent.
  • - they are private data → privacy issues; and if leaked they cannot be changed.

Exam wording: Biometric characteristics are unique to each person, so they are used for authentication; but they are private data, raising privacy concerns.
cards.zh:
直觉：你的身体就是密码，你不会把手指忘在家。

规则：

  • 生物识别设备读取生理或行为特征：指纹、面容、虹膜、声音。
  • 用于身份验证，因为两人几乎不可能有相同特征。
  • 优点：不会忘记、遗失或借给别人。
  • 缺点：属私隐数据，有私隐问题；外泄后不能更改。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Biometric characteristics are unique to each person, so they are used for authentication; but they are private data, raising privacy concerns.

ex.q: Give one advantage and one concern of fingerprint door access over keycards.
ex.a: Advantage: cannot be lost, lent or copied easily. Concern: fingerprint data is private; if leaked it cannot be changed.
ex.az: 优点：不会遗失或借出；忧虑：私隐，外泄后无法更改。

ex.q: An office uses face recognition for attendance. Give one advantage over signing a paper list.
ex.a:
1. A person cannot sign for an absent friend (buddy punching), since faces are unique.
2. Records are input automatically, saving time.
ex.az:
1. 面容独特，不能代签。
2. 自动输入记录，节省时间。

ex.q: A student says: 'If my fingerprint data is stolen, I can just change it like a password.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Biometric characteristics cannot be changed.
2. That is why leaked biometric data is a serious privacy risk, and it must be stored securely.
ex.az:
1. 生物特征不能更改。
2. 所以外泄是严重私隐风险，必须安全储存。

cards.en:
Intuition: output devices are the computer's mouth and hands: they show, print or play the result.

The rule: output devices do the last step of IPO: output images, hard copies, sound.

TypeExampleConnection
Wiredspeakers, earphonesUSB; 3.5 mm phone connector
Wirelesswireless speakers/earphonesRF (2.4 GHz), Bluetooth, Wi-Fi

Headphones rarely use Wi-Fi. Some devices are both input and output: touchscreen, VR headset, headset with microphone.

Exam wording: Output devices output processed information, e.g. images, hard copies or sound. Touchscreens and headsets with microphones are both input and output devices.
cards.zh:
直觉：输出设备是计算机的嘴巴和手：显示、打印或播放结果。

规则：负责 IPO 最后一步，输出影像、硬拷贝、声音。

  • 有线：USB、3.5 mm 插头。
  • 无线：RF 2.4 GHz、Bluetooth、Wi-Fi（耳机少用 Wi-Fi）。

同时是输入及输出：触控屏、VR 头戴装置、带麦克风的耳机。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Output devices output processed information. Touchscreens and headsets with microphones are both input and output devices.

ex.q: Classify: touchscreen, plotter, webcam, headset with microphone.
ex.a: Output: plotter. Input: webcam. Both: touchscreen, headset with microphone.
ex.az: 输出：绘图机；输入：webcam；两者：触控屏、附咪耳机。

ex.q: Is a VR headset an input device, output device or both? Explain.
ex.a:
1. Output: it displays images to the eyes.
2. Input: it tracks head motion/orientation.
3. So it is both.
ex.az:
1. 输出：显示影像。
2. 输入：追踪头部动作。
3. 所以两者皆是。

ex.q: A student classifies a webcam as an output device 'because it shows video on the screen'. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. The webcam captures video: it is an input device.
2. The monitor is what shows the video (output).
ex.az:
1. Webcam 拍摄影像，是输入设备。
2. 显示画面的是显示器（输出）。

cards.t: LCD vs OLED monitors (and the LED misconception)
cards.tz: LCD 与 OLED 显示器（LED 误解）
cards.en:
Intuition: LCD = a lamp behind coloured glass (the lamp is always on). OLED = every pixel is its own tiny light bulb, so black pixels can switch fully off.

The rule:

LCDOLED
Lightbacklight (CCFL or LED) through liquid crystals + polariserseach pixel gives its own light and colour; no backlight
Strengthslower price, more size optionshigher contrast, more consistent brightness, wider viewing angle, lighter, can be flexible/foldable

Misconception: an "LED monitor" is an LED-backlit LCD, not OLED. CRT (old): bulky, low quality.

Exam wording: OLED does not need a backlight; it has a higher contrast ratio, wider viewing angle and is lighter. An LED monitor is an LCD with LED backlight.
cards.zh:
直觉：LCD = 彩色玻璃后面有一盏一直亮着的灯；OLED = 每个像素自己就是小灯泡，黑色可以完全熄灭。

规则：

  • LCD：背光 (backlight)（CCFL 或 LED）穿过液晶和偏光片；较便宜、尺寸选择多。
  • OLED：像素自己发光发色，无背光；对比度高、亮度一致、视角广、轻、可弯曲。

误解：“LED 显示器”其实是 LED 背光的 LCD，不是 OLED。CRT：笨重、画质低。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：OLED does not need a backlight; it has a higher contrast ratio, wider viewing angle and is lighter. An LED monitor is an LCD with LED backlight.

ex.q: A gallery wants a very thin, flexible display with deep blacks. LCD or OLED?
ex.a: OLED: no backlight, so it can be thin/flexible and pixels can turn off for a higher contrast ratio.
ex.az: OLED：不需背光，可弯曲，对比度高。

ex.q: A school needs 40 cheap monitors for a computer room. LCD or OLED?
ex.a:
1. Main need: low price for many units.
2. Choose LCD: lower price and more size options.
ex.az:
1. 重点：数量多，要便宜。
2. 选 LCD。

ex.q: A shop says: 'This LED monitor uses the same technology as an OLED phone.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. An LED monitor is an LCD with an LED backlight.
2. OLED has no backlight: each pixel lights itself.
3. They are fundamentally different.
ex.az:
1. LED 显示器 = LED 背光 LCD。
2. OLED 无背光，像素自发光。
3. 两者原理不同。

cards.t: Monitor specifications: screen size, resolution, aspect ratio, refresh rate, colour depth
cards.tz: 显示器规格：尺寸、解像度、宽高比、刷新率、色深
cards.en:
Intuition: a screen is a grid of tiny coloured squares (pixels). The specs tell you how big the grid is, how many squares, its shape and how often it redraws.

The rule:

  • Screen size: diagonal length in inches (monitors often 22–24").
  • Resolution: number of pixels, e.g. 1920×1080 (HD), 2560×1440, 3840×2160 (4K), 7680×4320 (8K).
  • Colour depth: number of possible colours per pixel (bits).
  • Aspect ratio: width : height, simplified by the HCF (e.g. 2560×1440 ÷ 160 → 16:9).
  • Refresh rate: times per second the image updates, in Hz (60, 120, 144). Higher = smoother motion.
  • Letterboxing: black bars added when video and screen ratios differ, to avoid stretching.

Exam wording: Refresh rate is the number of times per second the screen updates its image (Hz); aspect ratio is the ratio of width to height.
cards.zh:
直觉：屏幕是由小色格（像素）组成的网格。规格告诉你网格多大、格数多少、形状及每秒重画几次。

规则：

  • Screen size：对角线长度（英寸）。
  • Resolution：像素数量，如 1920×1080 (HD)、3840×2160 (4K)。
  • Colour depth：每像素可显示的颜色数。
  • Aspect ratio：宽 : 高，用 HCF 化简（2560×1440 → 16:9）。
  • Refresh rate：每秒更新画面次数 (Hz)，越高越流畅。
  • Letterboxing：比例不同时加黑边，避免拉伸。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Refresh rate is the number of times per second the screen updates its image (Hz); aspect ratio is the ratio of width to height.

ex.q: Find the aspect ratio of 1680 × 1050 and 1920 × 1200.
ex.az: 两者都是 16:10。

ex.q: Find the aspect ratio of 1280 × 1024.
A student says: 'A 27-inch monitor means the screen is 27 inches wide.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Screen size is the diagonal length, not the width.
2. A 27" 16:9 screen is only about 23.5" wide (27 × 16 ÷ √(16²+9²) ≈ 23.53).
ex.az:
1. 尺寸是对角线，不是宽度。
2. 27 吋 16:9 屏幕宽约 23.5 吋。

cards.en:
Intuition: the same number of pixels spread over a bigger screen means each pixel is bigger, so the picture looks less sharp.

The rule:

  • Diagonal resolution = √(width² + height²) pixels (Pythagoras).
  • Pixel density (ppi) = diagonal resolution ÷ screen size (inches).
  • Same size, higher resolution → higher ppi. Same resolution, bigger screen → lower ppi. Higher ppi → sharper.
  • Rearranged: screen size = diagonal resolution ÷ ppi.

24" 1920×1080: √(1920²+1080²) ≈ 2202.91 → ÷24 ≈ 91.79 ppi. 86" TV 1920×1080 ≈ 25.62 ppi.

Exam wording: Pixel density = √(width² + height²) ÷ screen size (in inches), measured in ppi.
cards.zh:
直觉：同样的像素铺在更大的屏幕，每个像素更大，画面就不够锐利。

规则：

  • 对角线像素 = √(宽² + 高²)。
  • Pixel density (ppi) = 对角线像素 ÷ 屏幕尺寸。
  • 尺寸相同、解像度高 → ppi 高；解像度相同、屏幕大 → ppi 低。
  • 反过来：尺寸 = 对角线像素 ÷ ppi。

24 吋 1920×1080 ≈ 91.79 ppi；86 吋电视 ≈ 25.62 ppi。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Pixel density = √(width² + height²) ÷ screen size (in inches), measured in ppi.

ex.q: (Textbook Ch1 Long Q2(b)(i)) Set X: 1920×1080, 24"; Set Y: 3840×2160, 27". Find each pixel density.
ex.a:
X: √(1920²+1080²) = 2202.9; ÷24 ≈ 91.79 ppi.
Y: √(3840²+2160²) = 4405.8; ÷27 ≈ 163.18 ppi.
Y has the higher pixel density, so its images look sharper/more detailed.
ex.az: X ≈ 91.79 ppi；Y ≈ 163.18 ppi，Y 较清晰。

ex.q: A 27-inch monitor is 2560 × 1440. Find its pixel density.
A student computes the ppi of a 24" 1920×1080 monitor as 1920 ÷ 24 = 80 ppi. What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Screen size is the diagonal, so you must use the diagonal resolution, not the width.
2. √(1920²+1080²) ≈ 2202.91 → ÷24 ≈ 91.79 ppi.
ex.az:
1. 尺寸是对角线，要用对角线像素而非宽度。
2. 正确 ≈ 91.79 ppi。

frames.en: √4,852,800 ≈ 2202.91 px along the diagonal

cards.t: Display ports: VGA, DVI, HDMI, DisplayPort
cards.en:
Intuition: newer cables are like wider pipes: they carry more pixels, and the newest also carry sound.

The rule:

PortAudio?Resolution
VGA (oldest, analog)NoLow
DVINoMedium
HDMIYesHigh
DisplayPortYesHigh

Exam wording: HDMI and DisplayPort support audio and high resolution; VGA and DVI do not carry audio.
cards.zh:
直觉：新的线像更粗的水管：能传更多像素，最新的还能传声音。

规则：

  • VGA（最旧、模拟）：无声音，低解像度。
  • DVI：无声音，中解像度。
  • HDMI：有声音，高解像度。
  • DisplayPort：有声音，高解像度。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：HDMI and DisplayPort support audio and high resolution; VGA and DVI do not carry audio.

ex.q: A 4K monitor with built-in speakers must connect with one cable. Which ports are suitable?
ex.a: HDMI or DisplayPort: both carry audio and support high resolution.
ex.az: HDMI 或 DisplayPort。

ex.q: An old projector only has a VGA port. What problem may happen when showing a video with sound?
ex.a:
1. VGA carries video only, no audio.
2. Sound needs a separate audio cable (e.g. 3.5 mm) to speakers.
3. Image resolution may also be low.
ex.az:
1. VGA 只传影像。
2. 声音要另接音频线。
3. 解像度也可能较低。

ex.q: A student says: 'DVI is newer than HDMI, so it supports audio.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. DVI does not carry audio and supports only medium resolution.
2. Use HDMI or DisplayPort for audio over one cable.
ex.az:
1. DVI 不传声音，解像度中等。
2. 要单线传声音用 HDMI / DisplayPort。

cards.en:
Intuition: a projector is like a cinema: huge picture, but it needs a dark room and a wall.

The rule: projectors show images on a surface for a large group (lessons, meetings, films).

Monitor advantagesProjector advantages
higher image quality
less affected by ambient light
no flat surface needed
good for personal use		lighter, more portable
adjustable, much larger screen size
good for large audiences

A VR headset combines input (motion tracking) and output (display).

Exam wording: A projector has an adjustable, larger screen size and is more portable, but its image is affected by ambient light.
cards.zh:
直觉：投影机像戏院：画面巨大，但需要暗房和一幅墙。

规则：投影机把影像投到表面，供大群人观看。

  • 显示器优点：画质高、较不受环境光影响、不用平面、适合个人用。
  • 投影机优点：轻、便携、画面尺寸可调、可以很大、适合大量观众。

VR headset 同时有输入（动作追踪）和输出（显示）。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A projector has an adjustable, larger screen size and is more portable, but its image is affected by ambient light.

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.2 Q1) Advantages of a projector over a monitor: (1) works better outdoor in daytime (2) adjustable screen size (3) easier to transport
ex.a: (1) false: projectors are more affected by ambient light. (2) true. (3) true. Answer: (2) and (3) only.

ex.q: A teacher shows slides to 200 people in a hall. Projector or monitor? Give one reason.
ex.a:
1. Choose a projector.
2. Reason: the screen size is adjustable and can be very large, so everyone can see.
ex.az:
1. 选投影机。
2. 画面可调、可以很大，人人看得见。

ex.q: A student suggests a projector for an outdoor market stall in the afternoon. Is this good?
ex.a:
1. Projector images are washed out in bright ambient light.
2. Better: a bright monitor/display, which is less affected by ambient light.
ex.az:
1. 强光下投影画面看不清。
2. 应用显示器，较不受环境光影响。

cards.en:
Intuition: printer specs answer: how big, how sharp, colour or not, how fast.

The rule: printers make hard copies.

SpecMeaning
Printing sizeusually A4 / letter
Dot densitydots per inch (dpi), often called resolution, e.g. 1200 dpi
Monochrome / colourone colour vs many
Printing speedpages per minute (ppm)
Memorybuilt-in RAM (MB)
InterfaceUSB or network (802.11n/ac)

Exam wording: Printer resolution is the dot density in dpi; printing speed is measured in pages per minute (ppm).
cards.zh:
直觉：打印机规格回答：印多大、多清楚、彩色与否、多快。

规则：打印机产生硬拷贝 (hard copy)。

  • 尺寸：通常 A4 / letter。
  • Dot density (dpi)：俗称解像度，如 1200 dpi。
  • 单色 / 彩色。
  • 速度：ppm（每分钟页数）。
  • 内置 RAM；介面 USB / 802.11n。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Printer resolution is the dot density in dpi; printing speed is measured in pages per minute (ppm).

ex.q: Which is an example of a printer's resolution: 2'×3', 200×200, 1200 dpi, HD ready?
ex.a: 1200 dpi: printer resolution is dot density in dots per inch.

ex.q: A printer prints at 30 ppm. How long does it take to print 450 pages?
ex.a:
1. Time = pages ÷ speed = 450 ÷ 30.
2. = 15 minutes.

ex.q: A student writes printing speed as '30 dpi'. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. dpi is dot density (resolution).
2. Printing speed uses ppm (pages per minute): 30 ppm.
ex.az:
1. dpi 是点密度。
2. 速度用 ppm。

cards.tz: 热敏、喷墨及激光打印机
cards.en:
Intuition: thermal = heat paints special paper; inkjet = tiny water pistols of ink; laser = static electricity grabs powder, then it is baked on.

The rule:

  • Thermal: heats thermal paper. Fast, quiet, cheap, small; for receipts. Printouts fade, so not for long-term documents.
  • Inkjet: sprays ink droplets from cartridges. Very high dot density, colour, cheap to buy; but slow, high cost per page, can clog, smudges when wet.
  • Laser: laser changes the charge on a photosensitive drum → toner sticks → toner is heated onto paper. Fast, low cost per page, water-resistant; very high purchase price.
ThermalInkjetLaser
PurchaseLowHighVery high
Cost/pageLowHighLow
SpeedFastSlowFast
Dot densityLowVery highHigh

Exam wording: Laser printers have a high printing speed and low cost per page; thermal printouts fade over time; inkjet printers have very high dot density but high cost per page.
cards.zh:
直觉：热敏 = 用热在特别纸上“画”；喷墨 = 一堆迷你墨水枪；激光 = 静电吸碳粉再加热固定。

规则：

  • Thermal：加热热敏纸；快、静、便宜、细小，用于收据；但会褪色，不宜长期保存。
  • Inkjet：喷墨点；点密度极高、彩色、买价低；但慢、每页成本高、会堵塞、遇水化开。
  • Laser：激光改变感光鼓电荷 → 吸碳粉 (toner) → 加热印到纸上；快、每页成本低、防水；买价很高。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Laser printers have a high printing speed and low cost per page; thermal printouts fade over time; inkjet printers have very high dot density but high cost per page.

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.3 Q2) Mandy must print warranty certificates at the POS. Thermal, plotter, 3D or laser?
ex.a: Certificates are kept for months or years; thermal printouts fade. A plotter is overkill; a 3D printer makes objects. Choose a laser printer: durable, long-lasting printouts.
ex.az: 保修证要长期保存，感热纸会褪色；选激光打印机。

ex.q: An office prints 3000 black-and-white pages a week. Which printer? Why?
ex.a:
1. Large volume → cost per page and speed matter most.
2. Choose a laser printer: fast and low cost per page; its high purchase price is spread over many pages.
ex.az:
1. 印量大 → 重视每页成本和速度。
2. 选激光打印机：快、每页成本低。

ex.q: A student suggests a thermal printer for printing school certificates 'because it is fast and cheap'. What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Thermal printouts fade over time (heat, chemicals).
2. Certificates must last for years.
3. Use a laser (or inkjet) printer instead.
ex.az:
1. 热敏打印会褪色。
2. 证书要长期保存。
3. 应用激光（或喷墨）打印机。

frames.en: The photosensitive drum is given an even charge.
frames.zh: 感光鼓充上均匀电荷。

frames.en: Laser beams alter the charge where the image should be.
frames.zh: 激光在图像位置改变电荷。

frames.en: Toner powder is attracted to the charged image on the drum.
frames.zh: 碳粉被吸到鼓上的图像位置。

frames.en: The drum rolls over the paper; toner is heated and stuck on. That is why laser prints don't smudge in water.
frames.zh: 鼓滚过纸，碳粉加热固定，所以不怕水。

cards.t: Dot matrix printer, plotter and 3D printer
cards.tz: 针式打印机、绘图仪与 3D 打印机
cards.en:
Intuition: dot matrix = a typewriter hammering pins; plotter = a robot holding a pen; 3D printer = a hot-glue gun building layer by layer.

The rule:

  • Dot matrix printer: pins hit an ink ribbon. Low quality, but the pressure prints multipart (carbonless) forms → several copies at once. Thermal printers are quieter, faster, smaller.
  • Plotter: expensive; draws high-quality vector drawings by moving pens continuously (not dot by dot); for engineering/architecture.
  • 3D printer: makes physical objects from 3D models; used in medicine (dentures, prostheses), architecture, art. Vs moulding: faster, less material waste.

Exam wording: A dot matrix printer can print multipart forms to make multiple copies at the same time; a plotter draws high-quality vector drawings with continuously moving pens; a 3D printer produces physical objects from 3D models.
cards.zh:
直觉：针式 = 针像打字机般敲打；绘图仪 = 机械手拿着笔画；3D 打印 = 热熔胶枪一层层堆出来。

规则：

  • Dot matrix：针撞色带；质素低，但可印多联表格，一次印多份。热敏机较静、快、细小。
  • Plotter：昂贵，用连续移动的笔画高质素矢量图（工程、建筑图）。
  • 3D printer：由 3D 模型制作实物（假牙、义肢、建筑模型）；比倒模快、浪费少。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A dot matrix printer can print multipart forms to make multiple copies at once; a plotter draws high-quality vector drawings; a 3D printer produces physical objects from 3D models.

ex.q: A dental clinic wants customised dentures quickly. Which output device? Give one benefit over moulding.
ex.a: A 3D printer; it is faster and has less waste of materials, and each denture can be customised from a 3D scan.
ex.az: 3D 打印机：较快、浪费少、可度身订造。

ex.q: A logistics company needs delivery notes in 3 copies (customer, driver, office) printed at once. Which printer?
ex.a:
1. Need: multiple copies at the same time.
2. A dot matrix printer presses hard enough to print on multipart (carbonless) forms.
ex.az:
1. 需要一次印多份。
2. 用针式打印机印多联表格。

ex.q: A student says an architect should use a 3D printer to print large floor-plan drawings on paper. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. A 3D printer makes physical objects, not paper drawings.
2. Large precise drawings need a plotter (high-quality vector drawings).
3. A 3D printer could make a building model instead.
ex.az:
1. 3D 打印机做实物，不印纸本图。
2. 大型精确图纸用 plotter。
3. 3D 打印可做建筑模型。

cards.en:
Intuition: speakers are for sharing sound with a room; headphones are for keeping it to yourself.

The rule: speakers/headphones/earphones connect to the sound card and play analog signals, usually in pairs for stereo sound. Headsets with microphones are both input and output.

SpeakersHeadphones / earphones
a large group can hear
surround sound with many speakers
less risk of hearing damage
do not limit movement		more privacy, don't disturb others
small, light, portable
less affected by ambient noise

Exam wording: Speakers let a large group hear the sound with less risk of hearing damage; headphones provide privacy, do not disturb others and are less affected by ambient noise.
cards.zh:
直觉：扬声器是和整个房间分享声音；耳机是自己听。

规则：连接声卡，播放模拟信号，通常成对产生立体声。带麦克风的耳机同时是输入和输出。

  • 扬声器：大群人可听、环绕声、较少听力损害、不限制活动。
  • 耳机：私隐、不打扰别人、细小便携、较不受环境噪音影响。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Speakers let a large group hear the sound with less risk of hearing damage; headphones provide privacy, do not disturb others and are less affected by ambient noise.

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.2 Q2) Listening test for 100 students in a hall: one advantage and one disadvantage of speakers over headphones.
ex.a: Advantage: one set lets all 100 students hear at once (cheaper, easier to set up). Disadvantage: sound is uneven across the hall and affected by ambient noise/echo, so some students may not hear clearly.
ex.az: 优点：一套即可让全部人听；缺点：受噪音/回音影响，不同位置清晰度不一。

ex.q: A student studies in a busy library and wants to watch a lesson video. Speakers or headphones?
ex.a:
1. Choose headphones.
2. Reasons: do not disturb others, and less affected by ambient noise.
ex.az:
1. 用耳机。
2. 不打扰别人、较不受噪音影响。

ex.q: A student says: 'Speakers convert digital signals directly into sound, with no sound card needed.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. The sound card converts digital audio into analog signals.
2. Speakers then turn those analog signals into sound waves.
ex.az:
1. 声卡把数码音频转成模拟信号。
2. 扬声器再把模拟信号变成声波。

cards.t: Business use: video conferencing and cashier service
cards.tz: 商业应用：视像会议与收银服务
cards.en:
Intuition: video conferencing = a meeting room that lives inside the internet.

The rule:

  • Video conferencing: a live meeting connecting more than one party over the internet remotely. Saves transport time and cost, raises productivity, works during a pandemic. Devices: webcam, microphone, speakers/headphones, monitor.
  • Cashier service: receipts come from thermal printers: fast, quiet, low printing cost, small, cheap.

Exam wording: Video conferencing lets people hold live meetings remotely over the internet, saving transportation time and cost. Thermal printers are used for receipts because they print fast and quietly at low cost.
cards.zh:
直觉：视像会议 = 搬进互联网的会议室。

规则：

  • 视像会议：经互联网远距离连接多方的实时会议；节省交通时间和成本，疫情时也可开会。设备：webcam、麦克风、扬声器/耳机、显示器。
  • 收银：用热敏打印机印收据：快、静、成本低、细小、便宜。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：Video conferencing lets people hold live meetings remotely over the internet, saving transportation time and cost. Thermal printers print receipts fast and quietly at low cost.

ex.q: (Textbook Checkpoint 1.3 Q1) Devices usually needed for video conferencing: (1) microphone (2) webcam (3) MIDI keyboard
ex.a: Microphone and webcam capture voice and video; a MIDI keyboard is for music. Answer: (1) and (2) only.
ex.az: 咪高峰和 webcam；MIDI 键盘无关。

ex.q: Give two benefits of video conferencing for a company with offices in Hong Kong and London.
ex.a:
1. Saves transportation time and cost (no flights).
2. Meetings can happen quickly without gathering staff in one place, improving productivity.
ex.az:
1. 省交通时间和成本。
2. 不用聚在一处，提高效率。

ex.q: A student lists 'MIDI keyboard' as a device needed for video conferencing. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. A MIDI keyboard inputs musical notes; it is not used for talking.
2. Needed: webcam, microphone, speakers/headphones, monitor.
ex.az:
1. MIDI 键盘输入音符，不用于对话。
2. 需要：webcam、麦克风、扬声器/耳机、显示器。

cards.t: Electronic payment: POS terminal and self-service terminal
cards.tz: 电子支付：POS 终端与自助终端
cards.en:
Intuition: a POS terminal is the cashier's toolbox; a self-service terminal hands that toolbox to the customer.

The rule: electronic payment and self-checkout speed up transactions and reduce labour costs.

POS deviceRole
Magnetic stripe / smart card readerread card for payment
Numpadenter PIN for authentication
Barcode scannerproduct ID → name, price, offers
QR code scannermembership, e-payment
Thermal printerreceipt

A self-service terminal = POS + touchscreen and user interface, so customers do it themselves (e.g. fast-food kiosk).

Exam wording: A self-service terminal is an upgraded POS terminal with a touchscreen and user interface, so customers can complete transactions by themselves, reducing labour costs.
cards.zh:
直觉：POS 是收银员的工具箱；自助终端把工具箱交给顾客。

规则：电子支付和自助结账加快交易、减少人手成本。

  • 读卡器：读卡付款。
  • Numpad：输入 PIN 验证。
  • 条码扫描器：产品编号 → 名称、价钱。
  • QR code 扫描器：会员、电子支付。
  • 热敏打印机：收据。

自助终端 = POS + 触控屏和用户界面。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A self-service terminal is an upgraded POS terminal with a touchscreen and user interface, so customers can complete transactions by themselves.

ex.q: (Textbook Example 1.3 Q1) Devices commonly seen in a self-checkout: (1) smart card reader (2) headphone (3) barcode scanner
ex.a: Card reader for payment; barcode scanner for product data; headphones are not needed. Answer: (1) and (3) only.

ex.q: List the steps a customer follows at a supermarket self-checkout, naming the device used in each.
ex.a:
1. Scan each item: barcode scanner.
2. Check items/total: touchscreen.
3. Pay: smart card reader or QR code scanner; enter PIN on numpad if needed.
4. Get receipt: thermal printer.
ex.az:
1. 扫描货品：条码扫描器。
2. 查看总数：触控屏。
3. 付款：读卡器/QR 扫描器，需要时用 numpad 输入 PIN。
4. 收据：热敏打印机。

ex.q: A student says the numpad on a POS terminal is used to scan product prices. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Prices come from the barcode scanner + product database.
2. The numpad is mainly for entering a PIN (password) for authentication.
ex.az:
1. 价钱来自条码扫描器和数据库。
2. Numpad 主要用来输入 PIN。

frames.en: Barcode scanner reads each product ID.
frames.zh: 条码扫描器读产品编号。

frames.en: Smart card reader reads the card (contactless via RFID/NFC).
frames.zh: 智能卡读卡器读卡（RFID/NFC 拍卡）。

frames.en: Customer types the PIN on the numpad for authentication.
frames.zh: 顾客用 numpad 输入 PIN 验证。

frames.en: Thermal printer prints the receipt quickly and quietly.
frames.zh: 热敏打印机快速安静地印收据。

cards.t: Educational use: online lessons, library circulation, museum kiosks
cards.tz: 教育应用：网上课堂、图书馆借还、博物馆资讯站
cards.en:
Intuition: the same devices from shops and offices also let schools, libraries and museums work without a person standing there.

The rule:

  • Online lessons: video conferencing lets learning go on regardless of weather, location, traffic or pandemic. Need webcam, microphone, monitor, speakers/headphones.
  • Library self-charging terminal: smart card reader (validates library card), barcode scanner (book ISBN), touchscreen (simple interface), receipt printer. Users borrow without librarians.
  • Museum information kiosks: visitors learn without a tour guide.
  • Accessibility: for visually impaired users add speakers/headphone jack + screen reader, microphone with speech recognition, or a Braille keypad.

Exam wording: A self-charging terminal uses a smart card reader to validate the library card and a barcode scanner to read the book's barcode, so users can borrow books without librarians.
cards.zh:
直觉：商店和办公室用的设备，也让学校、图书馆、博物馆不用人手就能运作。

规则：

  • 网上课堂：不受天气、地点、交通、疫情影响；需要 webcam、麦克风、显示器、扬声器/耳机。
  • 图书馆自助借书机：智能卡读卡器（验证借书证）、条码扫描器（书的 ISBN）、触控屏、收据打印机，不用图书馆员。
  • 博物馆资讯站：不用导赏员。
  • 无障碍：视障人士可用扬声器/耳机 + 读屏软件、麦克风语音识别、点字键盘。

考试写法 (Exam wording)：A self-charging terminal uses a smart card reader to validate the library card and a barcode scanner to read the book's barcode, so users can borrow books without librarians.

ex.q: (Textbook Ch1 Long Q3(b)) Visually impaired users cannot use touchscreen kiosks. Suggest two devices and how they help.
ex.a:
Speakers/headphones: read out on-screen information and options (text-to-speech), so users need not see the screen.
Microphone: users speak their query, which is input by speech recognition instead of typing on the screen.
ex.az: 扬声器读出内容；咪高峰让用户以语音输入。

ex.q: Describe how a student borrows a book at a self-charging terminal, naming each device.
ex.a:
1. Tap library card on the smart card reader → card validated.
2. Scan book on the barcode scanner → ISBN found.
3. Confirm on the touchscreen.
4. Take the slip from the receipt printer.
ex.az:
1. 在读卡器拍借书证。
2. 条码扫描器扫书。
3. 在触控屏确认。
4. 收据打印机印借书纸。

ex.q: A student suggests a larger touchscreen to help blind visitors use a museum kiosk. Correct this.
ex.a:
1. A bigger screen does not help users who cannot see.
2. Add audio output (headphone jack + screen reader) and non-visual input (microphone with speech recognition, or Braille keypad).
ex.az:
1. 视障者看不见，大屏幕无用。
2. 应加声音输出（耳机 + 读屏）和非视觉输入（语音识别、点字键盘）。

mc.q: Which device is most suitable for creating comic illustrations?
mc.e: A drawing (graphics) tablet has pen control and many pressure levels.
mc.ez: 绘图板用笔并有压力感应。

mc.q: During online lessons, which of the following input devices may be used? (1) Monitor (2) Webcam (3) Printer
mc.e: Monitor and printer are output devices; only the webcam is input.
mc.ez: 只有 webcam 是输入设备。

mc.q: Which medium is NOT common in connecting headphones and computers?
mc.e: Headphones connect by USB, 3.5 mm jack or Bluetooth; Wi-Fi is uncommon.

mc.q: A powered drill should detect if it is overheated and halt automatically. Which sensor should be used?
Which is an application of OCR software?
o: Converting printed documents into a digital text file
Checking differences between two document files
Checking whether answers on an MC answer sheet are correct
mc.e: OCR converts images of text into text. MC sheets use OMR; subtitles use speech recognition.
mc.ez: OCR 把文字影像转成文字档。

mc.q: An elderly man is not familiar with typing Chinese on a keyboard. Which device would NOT help him input Chinese characters?
mc.e: A printer is an output device.

mc.q: Which is/are true about virtual keyboards? (1) Primarily used in portable devices to save physical space (2) More ergonomic than physical keyboards (3) Only used in devices with touch screens
mc.e: Virtual keyboards lack tactile feedback (not more ergonomic) and can also be used with a mouse or in VR.

mc.q: Which printer is most suitable for printing credit card receipts that require a signature?
mc.e: Receipts at POS are printed by small, fast, quiet, cheap thermal printers.

mc.q: Which is an example of a printer's resolution?
mc.e: Printer resolution is dot density in dpi.
mc.ez: 打印机解像度以 dpi 表示。

mc.q: Jacky sees black strips on the left and right of a video on his monitor. Why?
o: The aspect ratio of the monitor and the video is different
mc.e: Letterboxing adds blank space when aspect ratios differ.
mc.ez: 长宽比不同导致加黑边。

mc.q: Advantage(s) of a computer mouse over a touchscreen? (1) Lower purchase cost (2) Better hand-eye coordination (3) Faster text input
mc.e: Touchscreens are more expensive; hand-eye coordination is the touchscreen's advantage.
mc.ez: 只有价钱较低是滑鼠的优点。

mc.q: Statements about magnetic stripe cards and smart cards: (1) Stripe cards are more durable (2) Smart cards store data in microchips (3) Smart cards are harder to replicate
mc.e: Stripe cards are prone to damage and easily replicated.

mc.q: Advantages of a projector over a monitor? (1) Works better outdoor during the day (2) Adjustable screen size (3) Easier to transport
mc.e: Projectors are badly affected by ambient light.

mc.q: Devices usually needed for video conferencing: (1) Microphone (2) Webcam (3) MIDI keyboard
mc.e: MIDI keyboards are for music input.
mc.ez: MIDI 键盘与视像会议无关。

mc.q: Leslie prints her certificate. Advantages of a laser printer over an inkjet printer? (1) No blur on contact with water (2) Cartridges do not clog (3) Printout lasts a very long time
mc.e: Inkjet printouts also last long, so (3) is not an advantage over inkjet.

mc.q: In the IPO cycle, which step may retrieve or update data in storage?
mc.e: During processing the program may read or update stored data.
mc.ez: 处理阶段读取/更新储存数据。

mc.q: A student enters weights into a spreadsheet, which draws a histogram. The histogram is the:
mc.e: The meaningful result output is information.

mc.q: Which correctly matches IPO with a smart thermostat? Temperature sensor reading → comparing with the set value → turning on the heater
mc.e: Sensor is input, comparison is process, heater is output.
mc.ez: 感应器输入、比较是处理、开暖炉是输出。

mc.q: A wireless mouse with a small USB dongle most likely uses:
mc.e: The dongle is an RF receiver.
mc.ez: USB 接收器是 2.4 GHz RF。

mc.q: A keyboard layout is usually named after:
A tenkeyless keyboard lacks:
Why is QWERTY still dominant?
o: Users are accustomed to it and switching costs effort

mc.q: Which is a position-tracking pointing device?
mc.e: Touchpad tracks where the finger is.

mc.q: An LED optical mouse fails on a glass table mainly because:
o: its sensor detects movement by changes in light reflected by the surface
glass is too smooth for the ball
mc.e: Transparent surfaces give little reflected-light change.

mc.q: Reasons mechanical mice are obsolete include: (1) heavy weight (2) low durability (3) high production cost
mc.e: All listed in the book, plus inconsistency on surfaces.

mc.q: Why are trackballs common on information kiosks?
o: Their position can be fixed and they need little space

mc.q: 'Multi-touch' means the device can:
o: be used by many users in turn
detect gestures with more than one finger at the same time

mc.q: Tapping on a touchpad normally functions as:
Which interaction is difficult on a touchscreen?
mc.e: No hovering cursor on a touchscreen.

mc.q: A graphics tablet differs from a touchscreen in that it:
o: is controlled by a pen and has many pressure sensitivity levels

mc.q: Which converts the electrical signal from a microphone into a digital audio file?
A MIDI file stores:
o: musical notes or digitally sampled sounds
mc.e: MIDI stores note data, not a recording.

mc.q: A flatbed scanner captures an image by:
o: projecting white light and reading reflected light with image sensors

mc.q: An A4 page (8.3 × 11.7 in) scanned at 300 dpi gives a resolution of:
A 2490 × 3510 image with 24-bit colour, uncompressed, is about:
If the scan dpi is doubled (other settings unchanged), the uncompressed file size becomes about:
Colour depth of a scanner is measured in:
Webcam video quality is usually lower than a digital video camera's because:
o: webcams record in black and white
quality is sacrificed for frequent data transfer during streaming
mc.e: Streaming at the cost of quality.

mc.q: Compared with a barcode, a QR code:
o: can store text strings with any type of characters
mc.e: QR codes are 2D and store any characters.

mc.q: Why must MC answer sheets have circles completely darkened?
o: An OMR may fail to read partly darkened circles

mc.q: Smart cards that allow 'tapping' payments use:
Auto-rotating a phone screen uses a:
A car's parking assistant measuring distance to obstacles uses a(n):
Biometric devices are suitable for authentication because:
o: physical/behavioural characteristics are unlikely to be shared by two people

mc.q: An 'LED monitor' is actually:
o: an LCD monitor with LED backlight

mc.q: Which is an advantage of LCD over OLED monitors?
mc.e: LCD: lower price, more size options.

mc.q: Which monitor needs no backlight?
Screen size of a monitor is measured:
The pixel density of a 24-inch 1920 × 1080 monitor is about:
Two monitors have the same pixel density. Monitor P is 3840 × 2160, Q is 1920 × 1080. Then:
mc.ez: 尺寸 = 对角线像素 ÷ ppi。

mc.q: The aspect ratio of 2560 × 1440 is:
The aspect ratio of 1680 × 1050 is:
Refresh rate is measured in:
Which ports carry audio as well as video?
mc.e: VGA and DVI carry no audio.

mc.q: Which port supports the lowest resolution?
Which is an advantage of a monitor over a projector?
mc.e: Monitors are better in bright rooms.

mc.q: Printing speed is measured in:
Thermal printer printouts are unsuitable for long-term storage because they:
Which printer has the highest dot density in the book's comparison?
In a laser printer, toner is attracted to the drum because:
o: laser beams altered the charge of the photosensitive drum

mc.q: Which printer has a low cost per page but a very high purchase price?
mc.e: Laser: very high price, low cost/page.

mc.q: Dot matrix printers are still used because they can:
o: print multiple copies on multipart forms at the same time

mc.q: A plotter differs from other printers because it:
o: draws vector drawings by moving pens continuously

mc.q: Compared with moulding, 3D printing is usually:
o: faster with less waste of materials

mc.q: Which is an advantage of headphones over speakers?
o: More privacy and less disturbance to others

mc.q: Speakers used in a pair mainly provide:
mc.e: Stereo for a sense of presence.

mc.q: In a POS terminal, the numpad is mainly used to:
A self-service terminal differs from a POS terminal mainly by having:
o: a touchscreen and user interface for customers

mc.q: In a library self-charging terminal, the barcode scanner finds book information based on the:
Which benefit of video conferencing is stated for businesses?

Which of the following is/are usually found in a POS terminal?
(1) Barcode scanner
(2) Receipt printer
(3) Defragmentation software
mc.e: A POS terminal has card readers, a numpad, barcode/QR scanners and a receipt printer. Defragmentation software is not part of it.
mc.ez: POS 终端有读卡器、numpad、条码/QR 扫描器和收据打印机；没有磁碟重组软件。

mc.q: A company puts a QR code on a poster to promote its mobile app. What will the QR code most likely contain?
o: The URL for downloading the application
mc.e: QR codes usually store short text strings such as URLs; an app is far too large to fit.
mc.ez: QR code 通常储存网址等短字串；整个 app 放不进去。

parts.ms:
Easy/intuitive to operate (good hand-eye coordination) [1]
Combines input and output, saving space / no keyboard or mouse that can be lost or damaged [1]

parts.ms:
Quieter printing [1]

parts.ms:

parts.q: State one limitation of a projector as a display.
parts.ms: Image is affected by ambient light / needs a plain flat surface / lower image quality [1]

parts.ms: Webcam (digital video camera) [1]

parts.ms:
Content can be changed electronically and quickly, no new sheets to print/replace [1]
Can show video/animation; LED backlight uses less energy and lasts longer [1]

parts.q: List two disadvantages.
parts.ms:
High initial purchase cost [1]

parts.ms:

parts.ms:
Laser printer [1]
Faster printing speed [1]
Lower printing cost per page / printouts not affected by water [1]

parts.q: Why is a thermal printer not suitable for printing school certificates?
parts.ms: Thermal printouts fade over time, unsuitable for long-term storage [1]

parts.q: Calculate the resolution of the image.

State two ways to reduce the file size and one drawback.

Lower the dpi [1]; lower colour depth or use compressed format e.g. JPEG [1]
Drawback: lower image quality / loss of detail [1]

parts.q: Which monitor has the larger screen? Explain with a formula.

Same ppi, B has higher resolution so B is larger [1]

pr.task: Write aspect(w, h) returning the simplified aspect ratio as a string like '16:9'. Note: 16:10 should stay '16:10' when the simplified form is 8:5.
pr.taskz: 写函数 aspect(w,h) 回传化简后的长宽比字串；若化简为 8:5 则写成 16:10。
pr.solution:
import math

def aspect(w, h):
    g = math.gcd(w, h)
    a, b = w // g, h // g
    if (a, b) == (8, 5):
        a, b = 16, 10
    return f'{a}:{b}'
